title: fix(metadata)!: a removal deletes the artifact door's in-memory copy for every type, so a removed item stops answering
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgL3xXRGTsY5gDAn4ifTmSyT)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：元数据注销（`unregister` / `unregisterPackage` / `bulkUnregister`）现在对所有类型都会删除产物门内存加载器里的副本，不再只限按包存放的 api、agent、skill、action、permission。
- 为什么改：视图、对象、数据源、岗位等类型被注销后，产物门内存里的旧副本照样被 list、get、exists 读出来，删掉的条目又冒出来；先自定义再删除时还会退回包里的原版。
- 风险与回滚：属收窄（读不到已删条目），首方 6 个调用方实测在可达分支上不受影响；重载产物或重启即恢复包内条目。回滚即还原本 PR，只改一个判定函数。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `isRemovalTarget` 和 `unregisterAt` 第 1 步注释；`metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` 末尾新增的 #32353 describe；changeset 的 remedy 段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`，预期 282 例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前须过契约档复核）。

Fixes #32353

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -c -i -E "MemoryLoader|isRemovalTarget|memory: loader|unregister\(" -- 'skills/**'` has no hit (exit 1); `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx` names `MemoryLoader` as the door that hydrates artifact items, still true.

## What changes

#32246 (PR #32347) made `MetadataManager.unregister`'s storage half delete from the in-memory (`memory:`) loaders, the artifact door's store, for the types stored per `(package, name)` only. Every other type kept the residue: after an item the door loaded was removed, every read fell through to the door's copy and served it again.

- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`: `isRemovalTarget(loader)` admits a `memory:` loader that can delete for every type; the `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` condition (and the now-unused `type` parameter) goes. `MemoryLoader.delete` already removes a non-slotted type by name and a slotted type by `(package, name)`, so the slotted half is byte-for-byte unchanged. The `unregisterAt` step-1 comment is rewritten to match. 3 code lines.
- Seat ruling (claim amendment 6809474117), Q1 ruled A: a customization removed over a door item no longer falls back to the door's package body, the rule #32347 already applies to the slotted types.

### Moved answers (in-process `@objectstack/metadata` answers; no HTTP or MCP door)

For a type outside `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (today `api, agent, skill, action, permission`), e.g. `view`, `object`, `datasource`, `position`:

1. After `unregister(type, name)` (and `unregisterPackage`, `bulkUnregister`) of an item the artifact door's in-memory store holds: `list`, `get`, `exists`, on the live manager and on a manager whose registry is empty over the same loaders, and the loader-only reads `load`, `loadDiagnosed`, `loadMany`, `loadManyKeyed`: FROM the door's body TO nothing, until the artifact is loaded again (a reload or a restart restores it).
2. The same removal when a customization was registered over the door's item: FROM falling back to the door's package body TO nothing.
3. A host that registers its own `MemoryLoader` (the class is exported): `unregister` now deletes the item from it for every type (before: only for the per-package types).

First-party reach (step 0, read at `2513e3ad`, report `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/32353/step0.md`), six removal callers of these types, all through the same `unregisterAt`:

| caller | call | reachable on an artifact-door boot | moves? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectql `settleRuntimeObjectCopy` | `unregister('object', n, { notify: false })` | only a tenant-authored copy when the engine registry serves nothing under the name; every door object is in the engine registry, so no door copy | no |
| install-local `withdrawObjectCopies` | `unregister('object', n, { notify: false })` | install-local packages, not door-loaded; a door copy only if a door-loaded package is uninstalled there (not proven reachable) | that case only: the fix |
| datasource admin `deleteDatasourceRecord` | `unregister('datasource', n)` | `removeDatasource` refuses a non-runtime origin; door datasources are code-defined | no |
| datasource `applyMetadataDoorWrite` | `unregister('datasource', n)` | returns early for a code-origin name | no |
| runtime package-datasource withdraw | `unregister('datasource', n, { notify: false })` | only the install-local app's items; as install-local above | that case only: the fix |
| plugin-security `dropEcho` (`position`) | `unregister('position', n[, { packageId, notify }])` | an echo is registered only when no declaration is served, and a door copy is served | no |

The manager's `unregisterPackage` and `bulkUnregister` have no first-party caller outside tests; the `/meta` door's DELETE does not call `unregister`.

## Tests

`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` (the shared removal harness, so the pins go in as one top-level `describe`):

- Flipped: "a removal still never deletes from the door's store: its copy keeps answering (a separate card)" becomes "a removal deletes from the door's store too: nothing answers (#32353; BASE: its copy kept answering)": rows, the door's `loadManyKeyed`, `get`, `exists`, `list` all empty.
- New `describe('a removal of a type outside the set deletes the door's copy too (#32353)')`, per census call shape (`object` with `notify: false`; `datasource` bare and with `notify: false`; `position` bare, with the echo slot's `{ packageId }`, and the stale-slot drop's `{ packageId, notify: false }`; `view` as the CONTROL type), each over the door boot (door `MemoryLoader` saved first, then `register(…, { notify: false })`, one writable `DatabaseLoader`):
  - after the removal, `list` / bare `get` / `exists` answer nothing on the live manager and on an empty-registry peer; the door's `load` is null; the other name's row stays;
  - a customization registered over the door item, then removed: nothing answers (BASE: the door body);
  - CONTROL: another name's door item keeps answering, live and on the peer, and a re-register of the removed item serves it again.
  - a guard that every shape's type is outside the set.

## Acceptance notes

- A removal still reaches only the node it runs on: a cluster peer's door copy keeps answering there (recorded in #32347, unchanged).

## Verification

All on head `48eeeeac8` (branch head 4717d408 merged with `origin/main` f0f729e71; `main` has since moved to e765a092d, which touches no file of this diff).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test`: Test Files 73 passed (73), Tests 1284 passed (1284). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata typecheck`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (`!` title): closure build, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 451 passed | 3 skipped (454), Tests 3775 passed | 42 skipped (3817). The same counts on the pre-merge head 4717d408.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 64; all 64 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm lint`: exit 0. (Record: `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/32353/gates-ran-48eeeeac.txt`.)

<details><summary>Ablation (once, on the committed fix 754cde7e)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` with the call site `if (!isRemovalTarget(loader)) continue;` replaced by the BASE condition (skip a `memory:` loader when the type is outside `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`), then `vitest run src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`:

- mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 61b7eca68daf -> af81521d94df;
- `Tests  13 failed | 269 passed (282)`: exactly the flipped pin and the 12 new removal pins (6 shapes x {door item, customization over it}) at the ablated head `754cde7e`; the head after the contract-review patch round (`9c2faf5e`) carries 14 (7 shapes: shape 5 split into `dropEcho` `{ packageId }` and the stale-slot drop `{ packageId, notify: false }`); the CONTROL pins (another name kept, re-register serves) and every slotted pin stay green. First failure: `expected [ { name: 'shared_view', ... } ] to deeply equal []`; a shape pin: `expected { listed: [ 'door object' ], ... } to deeply equal { listed: [], get: undefined, ... }`;
- `ok restored: blob == HEAD (61b7eca68daf) and git diff HEAD is empty`.

A first attempt mutated `isRemovalTarget` itself; it referenced the parameter this change removes, so it failed 85 tests on a ReferenceError and is void (restored the same way).
</details>

<details><summary>Step 0 (read at 2513e3ad)</summary>

Scratch vitest, not committed: `view`, `object`, `datasource`, `position` over the door boot, each census call shape, three holder shapes (door item; customization over it; runtime item only), 26/26 green. Before: every door-held shape answered the door body after the removal, live and on an empty-registry peer. Report: `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/32353/step0.md`; seat ruling: claim amendment 6809474117.
</details>
